Question: Is CONSUMPTION_UNIT linearly associated with BILL_AMOUNT?
Sample definition: One available-history mean per consumer; pairwise complete averages; unequal history lengths retained.
Interpretation: Evidence of a nonzero linear association at 5%. Direction: positive. Positive means values tend to increase together; negative means opposite movement; near zero means weak linear association. Association is not causation.
Assumption/check note: Consumers, not monthly rows, are observations. Consumer independence is assumed; shared conditions may remain. Severe skewness/extremes can influence r and p; p-values are exploratory. A displayed zero p-value means numerical underflow, not exact zero.
